💡 طريقة الخليج في عُمان: فاصل ثابت للعشا: 💡 The Gulf method in Oman: a fixed interval for Isha, not a sun angle
تحسب هذه الصفحة مواقيت عُمان بطريقة منطق: This page calculates Oman's prayer times using the Gulf Region method: Fajr at 19.5 degrees below the horizon, while Isha is calculated with a fixed interval — 90 minutes after Maghrib — instead of a separate sun angle. This is Oman's official method specifically; the UAE, by contrast, uses its own Dubai method (18.2 degrees for both Fajr and Isha), not the same method as Oman.
لأن العشاء فاصل ثابت هنا، يظل 90 دقيقة ب: Because Isha is a fixed interval here, it stays 90 minutes after sunset all year round, unlike Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr and Maghrib, which change gradually as the Earth's tilt changes. The difference between Salalah in the south and Muscat is more noticeable than the difference between UAE cities, because the geographic distance between Omani cities is greater.
لماذا وقت العشاء ثابت بدلاً من أن يتغير: Why is the Isha time fixed instead of changing like the other prayers?
لأن طريقة منطقة الخليج تحسب العشاء كفاصل: Because the Gulf Region method calculates Isha as a fixed 90-minute interval after Maghrib, not as a separate sun angle like the other prayers — this is the method officially adopted in Oman (the UAE, by contrast, uses its own Dubai method, with Fajr and Isha at 18.2 degrees).
